description: Configuration schema for the moqx relay.

plaintext.description: Allow plain HTTP (mutually exclusive with tls)

track_metrics_enabled.description: Enable per-track counting and the /metrics/track endpoint (default false)

track_metrics_endpoint_default_limit.description: Max tracks /metrics/track reports when the request omits limit (default 10)

track_metrics_endpoint_max_limit.description: Ceiling on the limit parameter accepted by /metrics/track (default 1000)

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file

pkcs12_file.description: Path to a PKCS#12 bundle (.p12/.pfx) carrying the cert chain + private key; mutually exclusive with cert_file/key_file. Decrypted in memory (key never hits disk).

pkcs12_password.description: Inline PKCS#12 password (discouraged; prefer pkcs12_password_file). Empty for password-less bundles.

pkcs12_password_file.description: Path to a file containing the PKCS#12 password (preferred over inline).

pkcs12_password_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the PKCS#12 password (cloud-vault friendly: the secret stays out of the config file). Errors if the variable is unset.

require_setup_token.description: Require a valid setup token during CLIENT_SETUP (default: true)

allow_request_token_override.description: Allow request AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN to override setup credentials (default: true)

strict_claims.description: Also reject informational CWT claims; unsupported restrictions are always rejected (default: false)

audiences.description: CWT audience values this relay accepts. When set, tokens must carry a matching aud claim; when omitted, tokens carrying aud are rejected

issuers.description: CWT issuer values this relay accepts. When set, tokens must carry a matching iss claim

anonymous_claim.description: Anonymous (no-token) access grants applied to every request on this service, in addition to any verified setup/request token grants (default: none)

max_tokens_per_message.description: Maximum AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN parameters allowed per SETUP or per request message; a message over the cap is rejected outright. Required (directly or via service_defaults.auth) when enabled: true -- bounds per-message verification cost.

actions.description: C4M action names this scope grants without any token; setup/client_setup are rejected -- the anonymous claim never authorizes session setup

namespace_match.description: Namespace match; omit to match any namespace

track_match.description: Track match; omit to match any track

contains.description: Match namespaces containing this segment list as a contiguous run
Match track names containing this value

exact.description: Match this exact ordered namespace segment list

prefix.description: Match namespaces whose leading segments equal this list
Match track names starting with this value

suffix.description: Match namespaces whose trailing segments equal this list
Match track names ending with this value

id.description: Key identifier embedded in the token envelope

public_key_file.description: PEM P-256 public key file used for ES256 verification

id.description: Key identifier embedded in the token envelope

secret.description: Shared HMAC secret for this key id

max_tracks.description: Max cached tracks, ignored when disabled

max_groups_per_track.description: Max cached groups per track, ignored when disabled

max_cached_mb.description: Max total cache size in megabytes across all tracks. Default: 16. 0 is invalid. Ignored when cache is disabled.

min_eviction_kb.description: Eviction batch floor in kilobytes: when the cache exceeds the byte limit, evict LRU tracks until usage falls to max_cached_mb - min_eviction_kb. Default: 64. Ignored when cache is disabled.

max_cache_duration_s.description: Maximum cache duration (seconds) for any track; clamps publisher-set values. Also used as the default for tracks without a publisher-set duration when default_max_cache_duration_s is absent. Default: 86400 (1 day). 0 is invalid. Ignored when cache is disabled.

default_max_cache_duration_s.description: Default max cache duration (seconds) for tracks without a publisher-set cache duration. Absent: use max_cache_duration_s as the default. 0: opt-in-only — do not cache tracks unless the publisher sets a cache duration. N: use N seconds as the default for tracks without a publisher-set cache duration. Ignored when cache is disabled.

enabled.description: Negotiate MoQ Cluster on draft 18+ links (default: true)

hop_id.description: MoQ Cluster Hop ID (optional; random if absent, 0 is anonymous)

listeners.description: Listener definitions, keyed by listener name

service_defaults.description: Default settings inherited by all services

relay_id.description: Relay identity string (optional; random string generated if absent)

listener_defaults.description: Default settings inherited by all listeners

use_relay_thread.description: Dedicate one relay thread per service for relay state isolation (default: true). Disable for baseline performance comparison.

use_local_forwarders.description: Use per-subscriber-thread local forwarders to minimize cross-thread hops on the data path (requires use_relay_thread; default: false). Disable to run all subscribes on the relay thread via subscribeImpl.

mvfst_bpf_steering.description: Attach a classic BPF reuseport filter to steer QUIC packets to the correct mvfst worker based on the connection ID's workerId field (Linux only, mvfst stack only, default: true). Disable to fall back to kernel RSS distribution.

name.description: Deprecated: key the listener by its name instead

moqt_versions.description: MOQT draft versions: any of 16, 18, 22 in server preference order (empty = default 16)

mvfst.description: mvfst-specific CC tunables (overrides listener_defaults.mvfst; mvfst stack only)

quic.description: Default QUIC transport settings for all listeners

mvfst.description: Default mvfst CC tunables for all listeners

moqt_versions.description: MOQT draft versions: any of 16, 18, 22 in server preference order (empty = default 16)

mvfst.description: mvfst-specific CC tunables (overrides listener_defaults.mvfst; mvfst stack only)

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file

pkcs12_file.description: Path to a PKCS#12 bundle (.p12/.pfx) carrying the cert chain + private key; mutually exclusive with cert_file/key_file. Decrypted in memory (key never hits disk).

pkcs12_password.description: Inline PKCS#12 password (discouraged; prefer pkcs12_password_file). Empty for password-less bundles.

pkcs12_password_file.description: Path to a file containing the PKCS#12 password (preferred over inline).

pkcs12_password_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the PKCS#12 password (cloud-vault friendly: the secret stays out of the config file). Errors if the variable is unset.

insecure.description: Insecure mode, use default compiled-in cert

dir.description: Directory for per-session MoQ log files (empty = disabled)

sample_rate.description: Fraction of sessions to log (0.0-1.0, default 0.0)

max_cwnd_in_mss.description: Maximum congestion window in MSS (default: 860000 = quic::kLargeMaxCwndInMss). Applies to all CC algorithms.

pacing_enabled.description: Enable pacing (default: true). Required for bbr and bbr2; optional for copa and cubic; ignored (always off) for newreno and none.

enable_gso.description: Enable GSO (Generic Segmentation Offload) for packet segmentation (default: true). Requires kernel GSO support. Falls back to sendmmsg automatically if GSO is unavailable at runtime. Disable only on kernels or VMs where GSO is advertised but broken.

max_conn_packets_sent_per_loop.description: Max packets written per connection per event-loop iteration (default: 48). Written to both maxBatchSize and writeConnectionDataPacketsLimit so the cap applies in all batching modes.

use_recvmmsg.description: Use recvmmsg for batch receives in QuicServerWorker (default: true). Enables the recvmmsg kernel call to read multiple UDP packets per syscall, reducing overhead at high packet rates.

max_server_recv_packets_per_loop.description: Max incoming packets processed per event-loop read callback. 0 = unlimited. Default 64.

num_gro_buffers.description: Number of UDP GRO (Generic Receive Offload) buffers. 1 = disabled (default). Values > 1 enable kernel-side packet coalescing: up to max value packets are merged per recvmsg call, reducing syscall overhead at high packet rates. Max 64. Requires kernel GRO support.

ignore_path_mtu.description: Ignore the peer's path MTU and send full-size (max UDP payload) packets (default: false). Useful for testing or controlled networks where the path MTU is known; leave off to respect PMTU discovery.

adaptive_loss_time_threshold.description: Adapt the loss detection time threshold after spurious losses (default: false). Under delay jitter, a fixed 5/4 RTT threshold declares late packets lost and throttles the congestion controller.

bbr.description: BBR congestion control tunables. conservative_recovery also applies to BBR2.

l4s.description: L4S tunables (ECN CE target). Usable alongside any ECN-aware CC algorithm.

udp_socket_buffer_bytes.description: UDP socket send and receive buffer size in bytes. Default: 0 (use MoQServer built-in default of 1 MB). Increase to reduce EAGAIN errors under high fan-out burst load.

h3_txn_timeout_ms.description: HTTP/3 transaction idle timeout in ms; ends idle WebTransport sessions. Default: 0 (none). At most a year (31536000000).

conservative_recovery.description: Enter conservative recovery on loss (also applies to BBR2).

large_probe_rtt_cwnd.description: Use a large cwnd during PROBE_RTT.

enable_ack_aggregation_in_startup.description: Estimate ACK aggregation in STARTUP for more aggressive cwnd growth.

probe_rtt_disabled_if_app_limited.description: Skip PROBE_RTT rounds when the sender is app-limited.

drain_to_target.description: Drain cwnd to the estimated BDP after STARTUP.

ignore_inflight_long_term.description: Ignore long-term inflight samples when estimating bandwidth.

exit_startup_on_loss.description: Exit STARTUP on packet loss (default: true).

enable_recovery_in_startup.description: Allow cwnd recovery inside STARTUP (default: true).

enable_recovery_in_probe_states.description: Allow cwnd recovery during PROBE_BW and PROBE_RTT states (default: true).

enable_reno_coexistence.description: Coexist with Reno/Cubic flows (halve cwnd on loss).

pace_init_cwnd.description: Pace the initial cwnd instead of sending it as a burst.

override_cruise_pacing_gain.description: Override the PROBE_BW cruise pacing gain; -1 = use BBR2 default (~1.0).

override_cruise_cwnd_gain.description: Override the PROBE_BW cruise cwnd gain; -1 = use BBR2 default (~2.0).

override_startup_pacing_gain.description: Override the STARTUP pacing gain; -1 = use BBR2 default (~2.77).

override_bw_short_beta.description: Beta used to reduce the short-term bandwidth estimate; 0 = use BBR2 default.

delta_param.description: Delta parameter controlling the target utilisation (moqx default: 0.05).

additive_increase_after_hystart.description: Use additive cwnd increase instead of multiplicative after HyStart exit.

only_grow_cwnd_when_limited.description: Only grow cwnd when the connection is cwnd-limited.

leave_headroom_for_cwnd_limited.description: Leave headroom below cwnd for the OS send buffer when cwnd-limited.

ce_target.description: ECN CE marking threshold target (0 = disabled).

dir.description: Directory for per-connection QUIC qlog files (empty = disabled)

sample_rate.description: Fraction of connections to log (0.0-1.0, default 0.0; mvfst only)

max_data.description: Connection flow control window in bytes (default: 64MB)

max_stream_data.description: Per-stream flow control window in bytes (default: 16MB)

max_ack_delay_us.description: Max ACK delay in microseconds (default: 25000, QUIC spec default); mvfst ignores this field (logs DBG1 if set)

cc_algo.description: Congestion control algorithm (default: bbr). picoquic: bbr, bbr1, c4, cubic, dcubic, fast, newreno, prague, reno. mvfst: bbr, bbr2, bbr2modular, copa, cubic, newreno, none.

listeners.description: Names of the listeners this service is available on (absent = all listeners)

upstream.description: Upstream MoQ server for this service (optional; enables relay chaining)

upstreams.description: Several upstream MoQ servers for this service (optional; exclusive with upstream)

auth.description: Authentication and authorization settings for this service

max_subscription_buffer_kb.description: KB of a subscription's data the relay may hold unacknowledged (mvfst) or unsent (picoquic) before it ends the subscription with TOO_FAR_BEHIND; 0 is unlimited. Required here or in service_defaults; overrides service_defaults

exact.description: Exact path to match, must start with '/'

prefix.description: Path prefix to match, must start with '/'. Uses simple string prefix matching (not segment-aware): prefix '/abc' matches '/abc', '/abc/def', and '/abcdef'. Use a trailing '/' (e.g. '/abc/') to restrict to path segments.

wildcard.description: Wildcard pattern, e.g. '*.example.com'. Matches single-label subdomains only (foo.example.com), not the bare domain (example.com) or multi-label (a.b.example.com).

max_subscription_buffer_kb.description: max_subscription_buffer_kb for services that do not set their own

max_tokens_per_message.description: Default auth.max_tokens_per_message for services that don't set their own

idle_timeout_ms.description: MoQ session idle timeout in milliseconds (default: 5000)

relay_cost.description: MoQ Cluster RELAY_COST of what this relay sends on the link (default: 1; 0 is free)

ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate file for peer verification
